artworks.title: American Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from James and Christiane Valone in honor of Franklin Kelly
artworks.description: The painting features a valley with purple and brown mountains in the distance, surrounding a reflective body of water with a small rowboat floating on it. Closer to us, there are gray rocks, brown tree trunks and branches, and lush green vegetation at the edge of the water. The sky above is painted in warm shades of yellow, peach, and orange, which transition to pale greenish-blue at the top. The water below reflects these colors, as well as those of the distant mountain and surrounding trees.

artworks.title: Edouard Delessert
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Edward Wilson and immediate family

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene in Ecstasy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Nina J. Cohen in honor of her father Emanuel Cohen and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman sitting with her body turned to the right, her hands clasped around her knees and her head tilted up to the ceiling. Her eyes are closed, and her long, wavy hair flows over her shoulders and down her back. She has pale skin, and her face is illuminated by dramatic lighting, highlighting her round cheeks and small nose. She is wearing a white blouse with ruffled sleeves that drapes off of her right shoulder, exposing her neck, sternum, and part of her shoulder. Over this shirt she seems to be wearing a draped purple garment with a yellow border that covers her other shoulder and her legs. The background is dark.

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat

artworks.title: Tavern Scene with Standing Couple
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic interior with large objects, including a collection of ceramic pots, bowls, and raw vegetables like cabbages, carrots, and onions in the foreground. The color palette is earthy and warm, with browns, beiges, and muted greens. A table is on the left side of the image where several people are seated, while in the center, a man with his arm around a woman stands in front of a stone archway, surrounded by pottery on a wooden table. In the background, another figure can be seen through a doorway.

artworks.title: Still Life with Plums
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat
artworks.description: The image depicts a grouping of plums on a ceramic plate, an orange fruit on the left, a loaf of bread on the right, set on a wooden surface against a dark background. The plum colors and green leaves contrast with the orange fruit. The plate has a light design. A white butterfly hovers over the plums.

artworks.title: Still Life with Peaches and Grapes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat
artworks.description: The image shows a still life of round fruits, such as grapes and peaches, placed on a white plate. The color scheme consists of warm browns, muted greens, and deep reds. The fruits have a natural sheen. Positioned on the left center, the plate is filled with grapes spilling over its edge, with peaches of different shades scattered around. The background and support surface are dark brown, contrasting with the colorful fruit.

artworks.title: Low Tide at Scheveningen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat
artworks.description: The image features a seascape scene with a beach, ocean, and sailboats. The horizon is high in the image, separating the sea from the sky, where sailboats are present. The painting shows expressive brushstrokes detailing the clouds in the sky, boats on the sand, and people nearby. The color scheme includes sandy browns, muted greens, and vivid blues, creating a dynamic and textured visual.

artworks.title: Low Tide, Sailboats Run Aground
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miriam and Eliezer Benbassat
artworks.description: We are eye-level on a beach with half a dozen ships in view, sitting on the ground against a gray sky in this vertical landscape oil painting created with broad, unblended strokes. The horizon line is approximately a quarter of the way from the bottom of the painting, separating the damp sandy brown beach from the water and blue-gray sky. This landscape contains five grounded boats and one in the water. The closest boat to us is slightly off-center to the left. It is a sailboat with a light brown, tall pole supporting the sails that appears broken as it lies down on the dark brown hull. The boat is pointing towards our right. Behind this boat on the left is a very similar boat, but its mask is intact, and it is pointing towards us. Further back in our view are approximately two more boats, more indistinct but appear to be the same type as the closer boats. In the back of our view on the right of the painting, where the sand meets the water, there is a grounded brown boat with no mast. It is very small, and directly to its left, there are two indistinct people made of only a few brushstrokes. One step further behind this boat, in the water and on the horizon line, there is one more boat with its sails up that appears to be sailing almost out of the painting towards our right. Also on our right side of the painting, next to the closest boat, the beach has a puddle of water, which seems to indicate low tide. This puddle reflects the colors of the sky. The large body of water at the farthest view in the painting blends seamlessly into the sky, starting with a pale blue at the horizon line that darkens into a medium dark blue-gray as it moves towards the top of our view.  The words E. Boudin are marked in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: I Reread Them with Pleasure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edwin L. Cox – Ed Cox Foundation, Chester Dale Fund, and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman indoors. The man is seated on a red-covered piece of furniture and holding a letter. He has curly blonde hair and is dressed in a yellow vest, white shirt, cravat, and gray breeches. The woman is kneeling beside him, holding a piece of paper. The scene also includes a stool with letters, a musical instrument, a chair with a cloak, a sword, a hat with plumes, and a decorated cabinet with a globe and vase on paneled walls.

artworks.title: Deserved Sorrows
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edwin L. Cox – Ed Cox Foundation, Chester Dale Fund, and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a chair in a luxurious environment. She has fair skin, delicate features, and wavy light brown hair styled in a partial updo. She wears an elegant cream gown with a red overcoat lined in white fur. A maid holds a tray with a glass, a small loaf, and a gold pitcher, while the woman holds a silver platter. Next to the woman, there are ornate armor and weapons on the floor. A painting of a man in historical attire hangs on the wall. The room features wooden paneling and elegant furnishings.

artworks.title: The Artist as Lover
artworks.creditLine: Nell and Robert Weidenhammer Fund
artworks.description: This painting is a portrait of a person depicted from the waist up, turned slightly to the right with one hand raised to their chest. The person has pale skin, rosy cheeks, a thin mustache, and long, curly brown hair. They are wearing a loose, long-sleeved blue garment on top of a billowing white shirt. The background features a dark interior space with an arched window on the right, through which a landscape with trees and a distant spire is visible under a blue sky.

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Manfred Heiting, Los Angeles

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Susan L. Tang

artworks.title: Sir John Reade, Baronet
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper mounted to canvas (on strainer)
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up, facing slightly to the left. They have delicate features, light skin, arched eyebrows, light eyes, and light curly hair framing their face. They are wearing an elegant outfit with a richly detailed waistcoat with a swirling gold pattern, a dark overcoat, and a white cravat. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a dark, subdued gradient.

artworks.title: Allegory of Painting
artworks.medium: pastel and red chalk on blue laid paper mounted on canvas (on strainer)
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a young woman with pale, smooth skin and dressed in a light blue gown holds a paint brush and palette in this vertical pastel drawing. The woman’s body is angled to our right. She turns her head back to our left but then looks back off to our right from the corners of her eyes under faint brows. Her wide-set eyes are gray, her nose long and straight, and her delicate pink lips are closed in a slight smile. Her curly, ash-blond hair sweeps back from her forehead to gather in a braid across the crown of her head. Soft, loose tendrils frame her round face, which has touches of ice-blue shadows at the corners of her mouth and eyes. Sky-blue and white flowers with mint-green leaves adorn her hair to our left, and two touches of royal blue near her ear on our right suggests a ribbon. Gleaming white pearl earrings hang from her ears. Her dress is created with filmy layers of arctic blue, taupe, white, and pale pink. The gown has a deep, V-shaped neckline, and a long sleeve is turned back from the wrist we can see. In that hand, she holds the wooden paintbrush at about chest height, and it extends off the right edge of the sheet. In the lower right corner of the composition, the thumb of her other hand hooks through a hole in the palette, which has daubs of pink and white. The corner of a blank easel is visible over her shoulder to our right. The background is mouse gray tinged with the blue of the paper on which it is drawn.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with black chalk and white heightening on olive-brown prepared paper laid down on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing closely together. The woman on the left is leaning forward with her head bowed, while the woman on the right stands upright. The woman on the left has facial features partially obscured by her head covering, while the woman on the right has curly hair and wears a decorative band. Both women are wearing draped garments. The woman on the right is holding a sword in one hand and a large piece of fabric in the other, which is also held by the left woman, revealing a severed head with curly hair and a bearded face on the cloth. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Perugino's Udienza del Cambio in the Collegio del Cambio, Perugia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a detailed architectural drawing of an interior space. The drawing features ornate paneling, decorative reliefs, two large arched features with intricate designs, and detailed panels and molding. The background is aged and off-white.

artworks.title: Study of an Altarpiece and Ceiling Panels
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural and interior design sketches. The drawing includes detailed plans and sketches for an interior wall and ceiling design. The top section of the drawing shows a wall with an inset altar or decorative feature surrounded by panels and relief work beneath a rounded arch. The lower section details a geometric ceiling pattern with circles and triangular panels featuring classical motifs and floral elements, framed by lines and borders. Handwritten annotations provide guidance and labels for elements in the design.

artworks.title: Siena Brickwork
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a very faint drawing of an architectural building facade. It features detailed brickwork patterns, ornate cornices, and decorative arches over windows and doors. The lower level includes a main entrance door and a window framed with brickwork. The left side of the drawing is more detailed, while the right side of the drawing fades into faint lines that are hard to distinguish against the paper. On the right and near the bottom-right corner, there are notes with measurements and references to materials or techniques."

artworks.title: Palazzo Pollini, Siena, Attributed to Peruzzi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The drawing shows the front face of a three-story building with windows and a central door on the ground floor. The design includes details such as window frames, the cornice line, and the base sketched with parallel lines. Measurements and annotations are included along the margins.

artworks.title: Siena Cathedral, Entrance to Library
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural elevation of a decorative library door surround. The drawing features an ornate design of a doorway, including classical elements like columns, a pediment, and decorative carvings. It shows precise measurements and annotations for designing architectural features. The left side of the drawing is more detailed than the right side. Motifs and patterns are visible within the arch and around the framework, adding grandeur and sophistication to the design.
